options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: autoscaling_policy
options.description: If you use sole-tenant nodes for your workloads, you can use the node group autoscaler to automatically manage the sizes of your node groups.

options.name: description
options.description: An optional textual description of the resource.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: maintenance_policy
options.description: Specifies how to handle instances when a node in the group undergoes maintenance. Set to one of: DEFAULT, RESTART_IN_PLACE, or MIGRATE_WITHIN_NODE_GROUP. The default value is DEFAULT.

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: contains properties for the timeframe of maintenance .

options.name: node_template
options.description: The URL of the node template to which this node group belongs. This field represents a link to a NodeTemplate resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_node_template task and then set this node_template field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: size
options.description: The total number of nodes in the node group.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: zone
options.description: Zone where this node group is located .
